title: Grateful Dead Live at Rainbow Theater on 1981-03-23
lineage: MAC playback on Nakamichi DR-2, no NR > Presonus Firebox > firewire > PC, XP-Pro > recorded as 24 bit/96 KHz PCM WAV, Wavelab 5 > Waves X-Noise and L3 Multimaximizer @ 24 bit > UVHR-22 (dither to 16/44.1) > CDWAV 1.9 > WAV > FLAC
source: Condenser mics, portable JVC Boombox, 20 ft from stage left, hand held on a riser 6ft off floor > Maxell UDXL-Is

ai_review.summary: Round, up‑close audience tape captures a rare second‑set Birdsong and strong jams, delivering a solid performance despite B‑grade recording quality.
ai_review.review: The show is highlighted by an early‑set Birdsong – one of only three times it opened a second set in 1981 – and extended jams on Playing in the Band and The Other One. Reviewers praise Jerry’s clear leads and the overall vibe, while noting the tape is a boom‑box audience recording with a warm, round sound that lacks high‑end crispness but remains very listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly and describe strong performances; recording is a decent B‑grade audience tape, yielding an overall rating in the high‑four range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Boom‑box/fob capture with a warm, round up‑close sound; high‑end less crisp and slightly flat compared to other sources but pleasant and fully listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rare Birdsong opens a second set, setting an uplifting vibe; the show balances tight, melodic numbers with expansive jams, maintaining strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads are clear, deliberate and crisp as the crowd quiets.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums and space sections praised as great and soulful.
